description: This file defines the SchemefulSite class, which models a scheme and eTLD+1 for an origin, as specified by HTML standards. It includes methods for normalization, serialization, and comparison of schemeful sites, and interacts with URL origins and other components related to web security and privacy.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a scheme and eTLD+1 for an origin, providing normalization, serialization, and comparison functionalities aligned with web origin specifications.

methods.description: Constructs a SchemefulSite from a GURL.

methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite from wire data, validating the origin.

methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite if the origin has a registerable domain.

methods.description: Deserializes a string into a SchemefulSite.

methods.description: Serializes the SchemefulSite to a string.
